requiredBehaviors.behavior: establish a baseline before code changes
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Phase 1 requires performance-baseline and gates further optimization on reproducibility.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: route through hotspot analysis and an implementation-ready performance plan
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Phases 2 through 4 route through hotspot analysis, architecture checking, PERFORMANCE_PLAN.md and TASK.md.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: verify correctness and efficiency after small slices
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Phase 5 runs functional tests and targeted benchmarks after material slices, followed by two-axis review.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: perform a simplification pass and final benchmark before closure
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Phase 7 explicitly requires simplification, then repeat tests and benchmark before closure.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: jump directly from code reading to refactoring
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The orchestrator requires a reproducible baseline and measured hotspots before code changes.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: declare success with only functional tests or only a speed claim
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Closure requires both functional proof and achieved performance gate or accepted trade-off.
